```elixir title="Elixir"

result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("def greet(name):\n    return f'Hello, {name}!'\n", config_value)
IO.inspect(result.language)
IO.inspect(result.structure)
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.structure, 0).kind)
```
